name: L3
tagline: A trust and risk scoring dashboard built over two days for MIT Bitcoin Hackathon 2026, turning multiple signals into Gaussian scores, allocations, charts and alerts.
overview: L3 is a hackathon risk/trust scoring dashboard built for MIT Bitcoin Hackathon 2026. The README describes multi-signal trust scoring, Gaussian scoring, allocation logic, real-time updates, API architecture, charting, alerting, batching, caching, and performance fixes. This page describes the project technically as an analytics dashboard and scoring system.
